comment: Recorded Go behavior the Rust bridge deliberately does not reproduce yet. Every entry pins the exact (path-normalized, $ROOT) error text Rust returns instead: the Rust and Swift replays fail when a case starts matching Go (remove the entry), when it succeeds where Rust must refuse, and when Rust's text is anything other than expected_rust, so an entry cannot outlive its cause or hide a different failure.

cases.approval: CFG rows; not an FFI decision
cases.reason: A non-mapping YAML document is worded 'parse config: top-level YAML document must be a mapping' instead of yaml.v3's 'yaml: unmarshal errors: ... cannot unmarshal !!int `5` into config.VaultConfig'.
cases.expected_rust: load config: parse config: top-level YAML document must be a mapping

cases.approval: approved by the owner 2026-11-01 (ADR 0031, divergence D-SYMLINK)
cases.reason: Go follows the symlink and succeeds; Rust never follows a symlink inside the vault tree: opening, listing and verifying walk the whole vault with O_NOFOLLOW (STORE hardening, crates/symvault-store/src/rooted.rs), so one symlink anywhere refuses the whole operation before any entry is touched.
cases.expected_rust: list entries: vault path is a symlink: $ROOT/vault/entries
